national.summary: Advokat Munarman dorong pengusutan kembali tragedi KM 50 yang menewaskan enam anggota FPI. Rizieq Shihab bentuk Tim Advokasi untuk ungkap fakta kasus ini.

national.title: Batman Beraksi Atur Lalu Lintas di Jalanan Depok
national.summary: Muhammad Yunus mengatur lalu lintas di Jalan Ir H Juanda, Depok, mengenakan kostum Batman. Aksi unik ini dilakukan untuk menghibur sekaligus cegah kecelakaan.

international.title: Afghanistan explosion kills 10 students and injures more than 100, official says
international.summary: A spokesman for Afghanistan's interior ministry says the blast was caused by carelessness at an explosives depot nearby.

international.title: US regulators eye kratom as overdose deaths mount
international.summary: Kratom advocates say a ‘critical distinction’ should be made between natural and chemically enhanced versions of drug The US government is paying more attention to kratom after the apparent overdose deaths of young people, but advocates say the synthetic drug hurting people is not the same as the supplement and users should be aware of the difference. But chemical dependency specialists and law enforcement figures warn that the distinction may not be enough to curb an increasing number of fatalities and treatment center admissions for synthetic and semisynthetic kratom derivatives rather than natural kratom leaf.
